records.name: Ahmedabad
records.location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
records.description: Ahmedabad has historic Hindu, Islamic and Jain monuments and traditional neighbourhoods known as pols. Its visitor sites include Gandhi Ashram and museums.

records.name: Adalaj Ni Vav Stepwell
records.description: Adalaj's five-storey stepwell was commissioned by Queen Rudabai in 1499. Carved pillars and walls surround the descent to the well.

records.name: Calico Textile Museum
records.description: The Sarabhai Foundation's Calico Museum displays textiles and collections of Indian art in Ahmedabad's Shahibaug area.
records.best_time_note: Haveli guided tour 10:30â€“12:30, entry 10:15â€“10:30. Pre-registration required; closed Mondays and public holidays. Separate Chauk tour 14:30â€“16:30.

records.name: Kankaria Lake
records.description: Kankaria is a historic Ahmedabad lake surrounding the island garden of Nagina Wadi. The lakefront has recreation facilities, with a zoo and aquarium nearby.
records.best_time_note: AMC budget2022-23 documents wheelchairs at each entry point. This verifies a facility, not step-free access to every ride or zone. General daytime admission INR25 is corroborated by2026 travel guides; confirm current gate tariff. Monday closure and separate ride charges apply.

records.name: Sabarmati Ashram
records.description: Gandhi's former ashram on the Sabarmati river contains a memorial museum and preserved buildings associated with his life.
records.best_time_note: Open daily, including public holidays. Hridaykunj interior is temporarily closed for conservation; view from outside.

records.name: Sarkhej Roza
records.description: Sarkhej Roza is a mosque, tomb and palace complex associated with the Sufi saint Ahmed Khattu Ganj Baksh. Historic buildings surround a large tank.
records.best_time_note: A commercial walking-tour listing explicitly says its Sarkhej Roza tour is not wheelchair accessible. This does not establish accessibility of every part of the monument; confirm an appropriate entrance and route with the site.

records.name: Sidi Saiyyed Mosque & Old Pols
records.description: Sidi Saiyyed Mosque near Khanpur Gate is known for carved stone screens. The existing record also groups the old-city pol neighbourhoods with this mosque.

records.name: Lemon Tree Premier
records.location: Off Nehru Bridge, Sabarmati River Front, Ahmedabad 380001, Gujarat
records.description: Lemon Tree Premier, The Atrium, is beside the Sabarmati riverfront near Nehru Bridge in Ahmedabad.

records.name: French Haveli Heritage Stay
records.location: 1824 Khija Sheri, Dhal Ni Pol, opposite Jain temple, Ahmedabad 380001
records.description: French Haveli is a restored Gujarati heritage home in Ahmedabad's old-city pol neighbourhoods. Rooms occupy several floors; the property has no car parking and the final 100 metres are reached on foot or by rickshaw.

records.name: The House of MG
records.location: Opposite Sidi Saiyad Jali, Lal Darwaja, Ahmedabad 380001, Gujarat
records.description: The House of MG occupies an early twentieth-century mansion with courtyards and verandahs. Facilities include Agashiye restaurant, an indoor pool, spa and fitness room.

records.name: Agashiye Terrace Restaurant
records.location: The House of MG, opposite Sidi Saiyed Mosque, Lal Darwaja, Ahmedabad

records.name: Chandravilas Dining Hall
records.location: 3114, near Ratan Pole, Gandhi Road, Manek Chowk, Ahmedabad

records.name: Vishalla Village Restaurant
records.location: Opposite APMC Market, Vishalla Circle, Ahmedabad 380055

records.name: Champaner
records.location: Champaner-Pavagadh area, Panchmahal, Gujarat
records.description: Champaner and Pavagadh form a UNESCO World Heritage archaeological landscape containing fortifications, temples, mosques and historic water structures. Champaner preserves remains of the Gujarat Sultanate's former capital.

records.name: Jami Masjid, Champaner
records.source: Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps; published visitor guides
records.entry_fee: INR35 Indian online group-of-monuments ticket; INR40 counter ticket; shared pass conditions apply
records.description: Jami Masjid is a monumental mosque at Champaner, with carved pillars, minarets, a courtyard and stone screens.
records.best_time_note: Visit duration is the midpoint of published 1-2 hours. An older government report documents accessibility funding, not completion; wheelchair status remains unknown. Admission is a shared monument pass, which the current per-attraction budget schema cannot fully model.

records.name: Kevada Masjid
records.entry_fee: Shared Champaner monument pass; separate current charge unverified
records.description: Kevada Masjid is a mosque monument north of Champaner's citadel, accompanied by a separate cenotaph.
records.best_time_note: One hour is the lower end of a published 1-2 hour visit recommendation. Shared-pass pricing and conflicting separate-charge reports cannot be represented reliably as an independent fee; numeric admission remains unknown. Wheelchair access unverified.

records.name: Champaner Heritage Resort
records.source: Official resort; Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps Yatra quote
records.location: Village Bhamaria, off Champaner-Jambughoda Road, Gujarat 389360
records.description: Champaner Heritage Resort provides heritage-style rooms and suites, a restaurant, pool and garden grounds in Bhamaria near Champaner.

records.name: Hotel Sarvottam Restaurant, Halol
records.source: MakeMyTrip destination dining guide; Google Maps; Restaurant Guru
records.location: Baska, Halol-Vadodara Road, Halol, Gujarat 389350

records.name: Dwarka
records.location: Dwarka, western Saurashtra, Gujarat
records.description: Dwarka is a coastal pilgrimage town associated with Krishna. Its principal sites include the Dwarkadhish temple, Rukmini temple and Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, with Bet Dwarka offshore near Okha.

records.name: Bet Dwarka
records.entry_fee: Free general temple admission; transport and optional services extra
records.description: Bet Dwarka is an island near Okha associated with Krishna. This itinerary point is anchored at Shri Beyt Dwarkadhish Temple.
records.best_time_note: Road access is available over Sudarshan Setu, inaugurated in February 2024. Ferry is optional; no verified current ferry tariff is stored. Temple hours vary and include a midday closure. Accessibility guide reports steps near the sanctum requiring lifting assistance.

records.name: Dwarkadhish Temple
records.description: The Dwarkadhish temple is a Krishna pilgrimage shrine in Dwarka, also known as Jagat Mandir.
records.best_time_note: Darshan has a midday closure; published guide gives 06:30-13:00 and 17:00-21:30. Accessibility guide reports assisted entry via the exit side and a step near the sanctum; independent wheelchair access is not established.

records.name: Nageshwar Jyotirlinga
records.description: Nageshwar is a Shiva temple in the Dwarka area, traditionally counted among the twelve Jyotirlingas.
records.best_time_note: Accessibility guide reports rear entrance access and steep ramps requiring assistance. Wheelchair darshan is from an elevated area with restricted sightlines; direct access to the Jyotirlinga is unavailable.

records.name: Rukmini Devi Temple
records.description: The Rukmini temple near Dwarka is dedicated to Krishna's consort and features carved exterior walls.
records.best_time_note: Disability travel guide reports steps and uneven paths preventing wheelchair access.

records.name: Hotel Darshan Palace
records.source: Google Maps business listing; Booking.com; MakeMyTrip
records.location: Jalaram Road, near Laxmi Marble, Rampara, Ghanshyam Nagar, Dwarka 361335
records.description: Hotel Darshan Palace is a Dwarka hotel on Jalaram Road. Booking listings describe air-conditioned rooms, private bathrooms, Wi-Fi and parking.

records.name: Toran Hotel Dwarka
records.location: Near Circuit House, Civil Hospital Road, Dwarka, Gujarat
records.description: Toran Tourist Bungalow is Gujarat Tourism accommodation near the Circuit House in Dwarka.

records.name: Shrinath Dining Hall
records.source: Google Maps; Amit Gujarati on-location dining video
records.location: Home Guard Chowk, Dwarka, Gujarat 361335

records.name: Gir National Park
records.location: Sasan Gir and Devalia visitor area, Gujarat
records.best_time: Late November to early March (cool and dry season)
records.description: The Gir landscape is habitat for the Asiatic lion. Visitors can book guided vehicle safaris from Sasan Gir or visit the separate Gir Interpretation Zone at Devalia.
records.seasonal_note: Main jungle safari operates in seasonal slots; advance permits required. Devalia bus safari closes Wednesdays. This application does not enforce dated permit availability.

records.name: Devalia Interpretation Zone Bus Safari
records.source: Gujarat Forest Department official bus booking page; Google Maps
records.entry_fee: Indian weekday bus ticket INR150; weekends/festivals INR190; foreign tariffs differ
records.description: Devalia's Gir Interpretation Zone offers a short forest-department bus safari in a managed wildlife area.
records.best_time_note: Official bus slots last30 minutes. Stored window is winter morning service; winter afternoon15:00-17:00 also operates. Summer schedules differ. Closed every Wednesday. Permit availability and exact departure must be checked separately; wheelchair boarding arrangements unverified.

records.name: Gir Jungle Safari (Sinh Sadan reporting point)
records.source: Gujarat Forest Department official booking terms; Google Maps
records.entry_fee: Indian weekday six-seat Type B booking: permit800 + vehicle2000 + guide400 = INR3200; other dates/vehicles/nationalities differ
records.description: A permit-controlled guided vehicle safari through the Gir forest, reporting at Sinh Sadan in Sasan Gir.
records.best_time_note: Stored interval is the official 08:30-11:30 departure slot, not flexible admission. Report30 minutes early with permit and original ID. Other seasonal slots exist. Numeric cost covers one private Type B vehicle booking, not a per-person ticket. Current planner cannot enforce fixed departures or seasonal availability; confirm booking before relying on an itinerary.

records.name: Anil Farms Gir Jungle Resort
records.source: Official resort website and official-site quote displayed on Google Maps
records.location: Bhalchhel, Mendarda, Sasan Gir, Gujarat 362135
records.description: Anil Farms Gir Jungle Resort offers air-conditioned rooms on garden and mango-orchard grounds near Sasan Gir.

records.name: Hotel Gir Kathiyawadi Sasan Gir
records.source: Google Maps; Wanderlog dining guide; Restaurant Guru
records.location: Sasan-Talala Highway, Sasan Gir, Gujarat 362135

records.name: Modhera
records.location: Modhera village, Becharaji taluka, Gujarat
records.distance_from_ahmedabad: 99 km by road to Sun Temple (Gujarat Tourism)
records.description: Modhera stands near the Pushpavati River in north Gujarat. Its principal monument is the Solanki-era Sun Temple, with a sculpted assembly hall and stepped reservoir; the village also contains the Modheshwari Mata shrine.

records.name: Modhera Sun Temple
records.source: Gujarat Tourism; ASI ticketing listings; OpenStreetMap
records.entry_fee: INR20 Indian online admission; foreign online ticket INR250; booking conditions apply
records.description: The Sun Temple complex contains a carved shrine hall, an assembly hall and Surya Kund, a stepped reservoir lined with small shrines. It dates to the Solanki period.
records.best_time_note: Stored hours follow Gujarat Tourism's visitor brochure. Other sources describe sunrise to sunset. Two hours is a published visitor-duration recommendation, not a fixed tour. General wheelchair access remains unverified; entrance amenities do not establish access to stepped areas.

records.name: Modheshwari Mata Temple
records.source: Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps; local tour operator visitor guide
records.description: This Modhera shrine is dedicated to Modheshwari, a form of Parvati or Durga revered by the Modh community.
records.best_time_note: One hour is the lower end of a published 1-2 hour visit recommendation. Published daily opening hours conflict; confirm with temple before travel. Accessibility unknown.

records.name: Modhera Sunrise Resort
records.source: Official resort website; Google Maps Cleartrip quote
records.location: Behind the Sun Temple, Modhera, Gujarat 384412
records.description: Modhera Sunrise Resort offers accommodation including traditional-style bhungas and tents near the Sun Temple, with a pool and dining facilities.

records.name: Eulogia Restro Cafe, Sun Temple Modhera
records.source: Google Maps business listing; Restaurant Guru
records.location: Sun Temple, Modhera, Gujarat 384412

records.name: Rann of Kutch
records.location: Dhordo and the Great Rann visitor area, Kutch, Gujarat
records.image_alt: Kalo Dungar (The Black Hills) - Gujarat Tourism
records.description: The Great Rann is a seasonal salt landscape in northern Kutch. Dhordo provides access to the White Rann, while Kalo Dungar offers elevated views over the surrounding region.
records.seasonal_note: The white salt surface depends on weather and water conditions; monsoon conditions can change access and appearance. Permit requirements apply.

records.name: Kalo Dungar
records.source: Gujarat Tourism; OpenStreetMap; IRCTC; regional guide
records.entry_fee: No viewpoint admission charge; local transport/parking and applicable permits separate
records.image_alt: Kalo Dungar (The Black Hills) - Gujarat Tourism
records.description: Kalo Dungar is Kutch's highest hill, with views across the Great Rann and a Dattatreya temple near the summit.
records.best_time_note: Published visit guidance suggests1-2 hours. IRCTC notes over1km uphill from bus parking and limited local transfer options; wheelchair access to the final viewpoint is unverified. Road routes are approach routes, not proof of step-free summit access.

records.name: White Rann near Dhordo
records.source: Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps; local operators
records.entry_fee: Published adult White Rann permit INR100; vehicle permit and optional activities extra; confirm current permit tariff
records.description: The White Rann near Dhordo is a seasonal salt-flat viewing destination, commonly visited around sunset and full-moon periods.
records.best_time_note: A local published day plan allocates16:30-19:00 before dinner; stored2.5 hours is that visit allowance, not opening hours. Accessibility guide reports assisted access at the viewing area but uneven salt crust beyond it. Do not infer independent wheelchair access across the flats. Permit/seasonal access must be checked.

records.name: Gateway to Rann Resort
records.source: Official resort booking tariff; Google Maps
records.location: Dhordo village, Gorewali Post, Bhuj taluka, Kutch370510
records.description: Gateway to Rann Resort offers air-conditioned bhunga accommodation at Dhordo, with meals and a cultural programme included in published room packages.

records.name: Gateway to Rann Resort dining room
records.location: Inside Gateway to Rann Resort, Dhordo, Gorewali, Kutch370510

records.name: Saputara
records.location: Dang district, Sahyadri hills, Gujarat
records.description: Saputara is a hill town in the Sahyadri range in southern Gujarat. Its lake, hill viewpoints and museum introduce visitors to the landscape and culture of the Dangs.
records.seasonal_note: Check weather and local access before visiting hill viewpoints. Museum reopening has not been confirmed.

records.name: Saputara Lake
records.source: Gujarat Tourism; Gujarat Explorers; Google Maps
records.entry_fee: Free lakeside visit; optional boat rides charged separately
records.description: Saputara Lake has lakeside gardens and a boating facility in the centre of the hill town.
records.best_time_note: Coordinates identify the lakeside boating-house access point, not the centre of the water. Boat prices and operating hours are separate and not verified as a current tariff.

records.name: Saputara Museum
records.source: Ministry of Culture museum directory; Google Maps; MakeMyTrip
records.entry_fee: Current Indian adult admission and reopening unknown
records.description: The state museum documents the culture of the Dangs through clothing, jewellery, masks and other ethnographic objects.
records.best_time_note: Google Maps marks temporarily closed as checked September 30, 2026. The 2023 government directory lists 10:30-17:00, closed Wednesdays, second/fourth Saturdays and government holidays. Historical schedule is not stored as current hours. Confirm reopening directly before travel.

records.name: Sunset Point Saputara
records.source: OpenStreetMap; Gujarat Explorers; My Holiday Happiness
records.entry_fee: Free viewpoint; optional ropeway, parking and activities extra
records.description: Sunset Point is a hill viewpoint overlooking the Sahyadri landscape near Saputara.
records.best_time_note: Visit around sunset. Road routing does not certify final pedestrian approach or wheelchair access; optional ropeway service is not included.

records.name: Aakar Lords Inn Saputara
records.source: Official Lords Hotels website; Google Maps Cleartrip quote
records.location: Saputara-Nashik Road, opposite Lake View Garden Circle, Saputara 394720
records.description: Aakar Lords Inn provides hotel accommodation near Saputara Lake.

records.name: Anando Restaurant Saputara
records.source: Justdial restaurant listing; Google Maps hotel location; hotel booking listings
records.cuisine: Gujarati, Punjabi and North Indian vegetarian
records.location: Hotel Anando, Plot5 Nageshwar Mahadev Road, Saputara 394720

records.name: Somnath
records.location: Prabhas Patan, near Veraval, Gujarat
records.image_alt: Shree Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple - Gujarat Tourism
records.description: Somnath, also known as Prabhas Patan, is a coastal pilgrimage destination near Veraval. Visitors come to the Somnath Jyotirlinga temple and nearby sites associated with Krishna.

records.name: Bhalka Tirth
records.description: Bhalka Tirth commemorates the traditional account of Krishna being struck by a hunter's arrow near Prabhas Patan.

records.name: Somnath Beach
records.description: Somnath Beach is the sandy shore beside the Somnath temple area on Gujarat's Arabian Sea coast.

records.name: Somnath Temple
records.image_alt: Shree Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple - Gujarat Tourism
records.description: The Somnath temple at Prabhas Patan is a Shiva pilgrimage shrine traditionally regarded as the first of the twelve Jyotirlingas.
records.best_time_note: Trust provides wheelchairs and golf carts at the main gate and a lift inside the premises. Darshan 06:00-22:00; aarti 07:00, 12:00 and 19:00. Electronic devices must be left in lockers.

records.name: Triveni Sangam
records.description: Triveni Sangam is the pilgrimage ghat where the Hiran, Kapila and Saraswati rivers are traditionally identified as meeting the Arabian Sea.
records.best_time_note: The visitor area includes stepped ghats. Wheelchair access to the water is unverified.

records.name: Premier Somnath
records.location: Unique Plaza complex, Junagadh Highway Road, near Regenta Hotel, Bhalpara Part, Gujarat 362268
records.description: Hotel The Premier Somnath is a hotel in Bhalpara Part, offering air-conditioned rooms, private bathrooms, Wi-Fi and parking.

records.name: Honest Restaurant Somnath
records.source: Google Maps business listing; Restaurant Guru price range
records.location: Bypass Corner, Somnath, Gujarat 362268
